flashcard_questions.q: What is Al-Qadr in Islamic belief?
flashcard_questions.a: Predestination — the belief that Allah has already determined everything that happens.

flashcard_questions.q: Which article of Sunni faith is Al-Qadr?
What is the Lawh al-Mahfuz in Islamic teaching?
flashcard_questions.a: The Preserved Tablet, which records all that has been and will be.

flashcard_questions.q: What does ikhtiyar mean in Islamic theology?
flashcard_questions.a: Genuine human freedom of choice, for which people are responsible.

flashcard_questions.q: How do Shi’a Muslims use Adalat to argue about predestination?
flashcard_questions.a: Allah’s justice means He would not predetermine someone to sin and then punish them.

flashcard_questions.q: What comfort do Sunni Muslims draw from belief in Al-Qadr?
flashcard_questions.a: That hardship is part of Allah’s greater plan, even when it cannot be understood.
Patience and steadfastness in the face of difficulty.

flashcard_questions.q: Which angel will blow the trumpet on the Day of Judgement?
What happens to a person who receives their book of deeds in the right hand?
What does Surah 99:7–8 teach about the smallest deeds?
flashcard_questions.a: “Whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.”
Life after death — the eternal existence that follows the Day of Judgement.

flashcard_questions.q: What is Barzakh in Islamic belief?
flashcard_questions.a: The waiting state between death and the Day of Judgement.

flashcard_questions.q: Which two angels question the dead in the grave?
For whom do most Muslims believe Jahannam is eternal?
flashcard_questions.a: Those who committed Shirk by associating partners with Allah.

flashcard_questions.q: What does Surah 17:15 teach about responsibility for sin?
flashcard_questions.a: No one can carry another person’s sins.

notes: 15 cards: 6 term→definition (Al-Qadr, Lawh al-Mahfuz, ikhtiyar, Sabr, Akhirah, Barzakh), 3 denomination→position (Sunni comfort, Shi’a Adalat, eternal Jahannam for Shirk), 3 belief→source (Surah 99:7–8, Surah 17:15, book of deeds), 2 named angels, 1 article of faith. Left out the four things recorded before birth — it only works as an enumeration.
